Successfully increased VLC's maximum volume from 125% to 200%.

**Steps completed:**
1. Opened VLC preferences via Tools > Preferences
2. Switched to Advanced settings view (All radio button)
3. Searched for 'maximum volume' in preferences
4. Located the Qt interface settings (Interface > Main interfaces > Qt)
5. Changed 'Maximum Volume displayed' value from 125 to 200
6. Saved the preferences
7. Restarted VLC to apply the changes
8. Verified the volume slider now reaches 200% when set to maximum

The maximum volume limit has been successfully changed. VLC can now play audio at up to 200% of the original volume instead of being limited to 125%.
